features.name: AI agents for administration
features.description: Discussion of whether AI agents could automate administration tasks in Business Central, replacing traditional administrative roles or processes.
caveats: speculative discussion about future capabilities
no concrete timeline mentioned

features.name: Sales order agent
features.description: Referenced as an example of a new feature that conference attendees want to see implemented in real-world contexts, including setup and usage scenarios.
caveats: speaker is showing existing functionality
context is about how to set it up and when to use it

features.name: Telemetry component in administration
features.description: Noted as blending administration with development, allowing administrators to use telemetry tools to manage Business Central alongside traditional administrative tasks.
caveats: speaker is describing existing tools
emphasis on blurring lines between administration and development

features.name: Custom agents for Business Central
features.description: Development teams building custom agents to handle specific tasks and sharing implementations across the group to improve AI adoption.
caveats: Teams still at different points in AI adoption
Lack of standardized approach

features.name: AI-assisted code unit optimization
features.description: Using AI to write smaller code units instead of massive ones to reduce token consumption for GitHub Copilot billing.
caveats: GitHub changed to paid credits model
Billing structure creates pressure to optimize token usage

features.name: AI for Business Central performance testing
features.description: Using AI to help write test code units and performance testing procedures with the Business Central Performance Toolkit to ensure stable upgrades.
caveats: Requires test-driven development mindset
Time investment still needed for setup

features.name: AI-generated documentation
features.description: AI tools generating documentation for extensions and procedures that developers adjust rather than write from scratch.
caveats: Generated documentation requires adjustment
Not a one-for-one replacement for manual documentation

features.name: AI for solution design and architecture
features.description: Teams using AI extensively in the planning and design phase before development, leveraging AI to access all existing designs and catch edge cases.
caveats: Requires good upfront design to avoid bad code
Time allocation shift from coding to design

features.name: Multi-model AI approach for design review
features.description: Using Claude for initial design, ChatGPT for code review, and Gemini for secondary design review to build layers of quality into solution design.
caveats: Requires trust in multiple AI models
All models can produce convincing but incorrect results
Increases overall cost by paying for multiple subscriptions

features.name: Copilot for code generation
features.description: Using Copilot or Claude Code to generate approximately 80% of development code, with developers manually fixing field names and posting setup references that require domain knowledge.
caveats: Field naming can be incorrect
Setup references may need correction
Business Central specific knowledge still required
Requires manual fixes for domain-specific naming conventions

features.name: GitHub Copilot credit-based pricing model
features.description: Shift from monthly pay plan with fixed usage allocation to actual credit usage-based pricing, requiring developers to track and manage credit consumption.
caveats: Complicates ROI calculation for development tasks
Creates new cost visibility challenges

features.name: Responsible AI model usage by developer experience level
features.description: Strategy to allocate more expensive AI models (Claude) to experienced developers tackling complex problems, and cheaper models to junior developers, with techniques to reduce token burn through better practices.
caveats: Requires ongoing monitoring and adjustment of credit allocation
Junior developers may still burn tokens faster due to learning curve

features.name: Code review agent
features.description: AI-powered code review agent built to provide automated feedback, with questions about selective deployment to avoid unnecessary credit consumption.
caveats: Cost-benefit analysis needed for commit-level deployment
May burn credits unnecessarily if overused

features.name: Cheaper AI model usage for documentation and code reviews
features.description: Using lower-cost models like Codex for documentation and code review tasks, trading off some quality for significant cost savings, achieving approximately 80% of the quality of premium models.
caveats: Quality trade-offs with cheaper models
Requires developer judgment to identify where quality gap is acceptable
